kangaroo-island-37.name: Timber Creek Walk
kangaroo-island-37.bio: A short walk beside Murray Lagoon's tea-tree swamp, where ducks, swans and waders gather.
kangaroo-island-37.coordinates_source: southaustralia.com listing geotag (Timber Creek Walk, Seagers Road); LOW: not an OSM feature, trailhead-type point 500 m west of Murray Lagoon campground, not the route midpoint
notes: pin LOW: no OSM route found (Overpass was down); listing point used. Trail floods in winter. NPWS: vehicle entry to Cape Gantheaume is free. Price 'Free' on southaustralia.com listing.

kangaroo-island-38.name: Curley Creek Hike
kangaroo-island-38.bio: A hike along an old fire track at the edge of Murray Lagoon, with waders and varied vegetation.
kangaroo-island-38.coordinates_source: southaustralia.com listing geotag (Curley Creek Hike); LOW: trailhead at Curley Creek, not the route midpoint (route ends at Bald Hill Walk 2 km west of the campground)
notes: pin LOW: trailhead point; no OSM route found. Winter flooding. Entry to the park is free (NPWS).

kangaroo-island-39.name: Tadpole Cove Walk
kangaroo-island-39.bio: A walk from an old grain threshing floor past settler cottage ruins to a lookout above Tadpole Cove.
kangaroo-island-39.coordinates_source: southaustralia.com listing geotag (Tadpole Cove Walk); LOW: start/car park by the threshing floor off D'Estrees Bay Road, not the route midpoint
notes: pin LOW: trailhead point; no OSM route found. Entry free (NPWS). Bio omits ospreys (draft claim not sourced on NPWS page; NPWS mentions osprey markers on the D'Estrees Bay Road drive).

kangaroo-island-40.name: D'Estrees Bay
kangaroo-island-40.bio: A south coast bay of surf and fishing beaches, with a link to the island's early whaling industry.
kangaroo-island-40.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap natural=beach 'Wreckers Beach' on D'Estrees Bay (photon); bay centroid (-35.9179,137.6478) is in the water, so the beach access is used
notes: MEDIUM pin: one OSM beach feature at the southern end of the bay (Wreckers Beach), 450 m from Tadpole Cove Walk's start. Park entry free (NPWS). Wikipedia article 'D'Estrees Bay' matches the name, so no wiki field.

kangaroo-island-41.name: Duck Lagoon
kangaroo-island-41.bio: A lagoon near Cygnet River with koalas, a bird hide and a trail to old eucalyptus distillery ruins.
kangaroo-island-41.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap tourism=camp_site 'Duck Lagoon' (photon), the lagoon's access/picnic point; lake centroid -35.7073,137.4957 is 250 m away
notes: MEDIUM pin: visitor access point beside the lake. No fee stated by tourism board; treated as free/open - confirm. Bird hide and distillery ruins per Wikivoyage/tourism board.

kangaroo-island-42.name: Parndana Soldier Settlement Museum
kangaroo-island-42.bio: A small museum in Parndana's old RSL hall on the soldier settlement scheme of the early 1950s.
kangaroo-island-42.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap tourism=museum (photon) -35.791823,137.263688, matches southaustralia.com listing geotag within 30 m (HIGH)
notes: Entry fee is described as 'nominal' with no amount found: cost left empty (unverified). Community directory lists limited weekday/Sunday opening; address Wedgwood Road, Parndana. Size: small, one-source museum; keep per judge.
kangaroo-island-42.ticket_note: No museum website found (only email on listing)

kangaroo-island-43.name: Harriet River
kangaroo-island-43.bio: A calm river at Vivonne Bay for swimming and kayaking, with koalas and echidnas to spot.
kangaroo-island-43.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap waterway=river 'Harriet River' (nominatim) point on the lower river near Vivonne Bay; MEDIUM
notes: MEDIUM pin: a point on the river line, not a surveyed launch point. No fee stated. Wikipedia 'Harriet River' only redirects to Vivonne Bay section: no wiki field; photo needs a manual pick.

kangaroo-island-44.name: Point Ellen
kangaroo-island-44.bio: A headland west of Vivonne Bay with Southern Ocean surf and turquoise rock pools to swim in.
kangaroo-island-44.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap tourism=viewpoint 'Point Ellen' (photon) within 33 m of southaustralia.com listing geotag (HIGH)
notes: Tourism board warns of swell; take care near the water. No fee stated.

kangaroo-island-45.name: Hanson Bay
kangaroo-island-45.bio: A south-west coast beach where the Southern Ocean rolls in, with dunes to walk to three beaches.
kangaroo-island-45.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap natural=beach 'Hanson Bay Beach' (photon); MEDIUM. Not the NZ Hanson Bay the candidate coordinates pointed to
notes: Wikipedia 'Hanson Bay' is the New Zealand place: leave wiki unset and set a photo override by hand (NO_PHOTO if none). No fee stated.

kangaroo-island-46.name: West Bay
kangaroo-island-46.bio: The island's westernmost inlet at the Rocky River mouth, with sea views and wildlife.
notes: West Bay lies inside Flinders Chase National Park (NPWS lists West Bay Campground, 4WD only), so the park's site entry $22.40 per person applies (parks.sa.gov.au, read 2026-10-25). Daily validity not stated on the page, hence costPer 'Per Person'. The Kangaroo Island Tour Pass also covers park entry (not in parkPasses.ts). Check 4WD-only access before sending visitors.

kangaroo-island-47.name: Western River Cove
kangaroo-island-47.bio: A beach and campground beneath cliffs at the Western River mouth, home to glossy black cockatoos.
kangaroo-island-47.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap natural=beach 'Western River Cove' (photon); MEDIUM; campsite 220 m away at -35.6778,136.9717
notes: No wiki field: Wikipedia 'Western River' is the river, not the cove. No day-use fee stated; campsite fees apply for camping. Access by unsealed road; verify with NPWS.
kangaroo-island-47.ticket_note: No steward page loaded; not verified

kangaroo-island-48.name: Ravine des Casoars
kangaroo-island-48.bio: A wilderness protection area by Cape Borda, with a hiking trail down the Valley of the Cassowaries.
kangaroo-island-48.coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap highway=path 'Ravine Des Casoars Hike' (photon); a point on the route (midpoint not confirmed); MEDIUM
notes: NPWS fee panel covers 'Flinders Chase National Park and Ravine Des Casoars Wilderness Protection Area': site entry $22.40 per person. Wikipedia 'Ravine des Casoars' matches the name; draft wiki (WPA title) dropped. Trail is long (hours) - visit range kept from draft.
